nodes.label: Early Theme Initialization Script
nodes.rationale: Runs synchronous inline script before DOM rendering to read fs-theme localStorage or system preference and apply dark theme class, preventing flash of unstyled content (FOUC).

nodes.label: Content Security Policy and Security Headers
nodes.norm_label: content security policy and security headers
nodes.rationale: Enforces strict defense-in-depth headers including CSP, X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff, strict referrer, and restricted Permissions-Policy to protect against XSS and clickjacking.

nodes.label: Superseded Run Cancellation Strategy
nodes.rationale: Cancels in-progress workflow runs on rapid consecutive git pushes to conserve CI runner compute.

nodes.label: Clean Docker Compose Validation Rationale
nodes.rationale: Runs docker compose config with -q to quietly validate compose YAML syntax and structure without logging resolved configuration or failing on optional missing .env files.
